subject: Mid-contract capacity top-up & co-term alignment
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya@solstice.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: mid-contract capacity top-up & co-term alignment

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from procurement — we saw usage spike over the last six weeks and need to secure a ~35% capacity top-up to avoid throttling next month. Current contract runs to 2026-03-31 and we want the top-up to co-term with the existing renewal date (so no new 12-month reset).

Questions:
- Can Redwood provide a mid-contract amendment that: adds the top-up, pro-rates to 2026-03-31, and preserves current volume pricing tiering?
- Any uplift discounts for committing to the top-up now (we can commit to a +12 month option at renewal if that helps)?
- We have a procurement deadline: signatures by 2025-11-12 to avoid project delays.

Attachments: none on this side.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30m to align.

Priya Shah
Head of Procurement, Solstice AI
priay@solstice.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Solstice AI (www.solstice.ai)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@solstice.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract capacity top-up & co-term alignment

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the lift. We can support a mid-contract amendment that adds the requested capacity and co-terms to 2026-03-31.

High-level proposal (we'll formalize in the amendment doc):
- Add 35% additional reserved units (same SKU) effective upon amendment execution.
- Pro-rate the top-up to 2026-03-31.
- Maintain existing per-unit price for the original baseline; apply a negotiated uplift rate on the new units.
- For an execution by 2025-11-12 we can offer a 7.5% uplift discount on the added units. If Solstice commits to a +12 month contract extension at renewal, we can increase that to 10%.

I attached a short quote stub with numbers and two options (7.5% now / 10% with commit). Let me know if you want a call — happy to walk procurement and legal through the amendment.

Attachment: proposed_uplift_quote.pdf (PDF, 1 page — topline pricing options)

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 617-555-0199
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 4 Nov 2025 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Solstice AI — approval request for 7.5% mid-contract uplift discount

Team — looping you in (internal) before I send a formal amendment. Summary: Solstice needs +35% capacity mid-contract; procurement deadline 11/12. I proposed a 7.5% uplift discount on the new units if they sign by 11/12; 10% if they commit to a 12-month extension at renewal.

Need input:
- lauren: pricing floor for this account and whether 7.5% is within delegated authority vs exec approval.
- ben: any SLA or capacity carveouts we should reserve in the amendment (they asked to keep the same volume pricing tiers).

Context: Solstice is in Production with latency-sensitive inference. They are in our mid-enterprise segment and have been trending +28% MoM for the bot project. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (deal in progress).

Thanks — Jonas

Jonas — thanks for the heads-up. Quick notes: 7.5% is within regional quota but any permanent change to the effective seat/unit price requires exec signoff if the amendment has SLA carveouts or term extension options. If this is purely a pro-rated top-up with the same SLA and no new credits, I can approve 7.5% from GTM budget.

Requests before we proceed to legal:
- Add explicit language that the top-up is pro-rated to the existing renewal date and that volume tier thresholds remain unchanged.
- No auto-renew of the top-up; renewal behavior governed by the existing contract.
- Ask CS to confirm current usage profile and any KV-cache or burst patterns; I don't want unexpected latency SLO exposure. CC'ing Neha for CS verification.

If Solstice accepts the 10% conditional (12-month renewal extension), that would need VP-level approval — flag that as an exec approval path in the amendment.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@solstice.ai>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract capacity top-up & co-term alignment

Hi Priya — thanks for the details and the timeline. Per our internal review: we can proceed with the pro-rated top-up and co-term the added capacity to 2026-03-31. Below are the finalized options for your procurement team.

Option A — Quick execution (sign by 2025-11-12):
- Add +35% reserved units, pro-rated to 2026-03-31.
- Uplift pricing on new units: 7.5% discount vs list for the remainder of the term.
- No change to existing volume tier thresholds.
- Amendment includes standard Redwood SLOs; no SLA expansions.

Option B — Committed renewal extension (sign by 2025-11-12 + commit to extend at renewal):
- Same top-up, pro-rated.
- Uplift pricing on new units: 10% discount vs list for the remainder of the term.
- Includes a mutual agreement to review pricing at renewal with a target end-state to annualize and consolidate commitments.

Next steps: I attached a draft amendment (amendment_draft.docx) and an updated one-page quote. If procurement signs Option A we can turn this around and route to legal for signature within 48 hours. For Option B we will route to VP for approval once you confirm the renewal extension term.

Attachments: amendment_draft.docx (Word, 3 pages — draft language), proposed_uplift_quote.pdf (updated)

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 30m call if that helps.

Best,
Ben Carter
